column1: # Pinned projects for the corpus oracle (bench/oracle/README.md). One project per line,
# tab-separated; adding a project is adding a line. Columns:
#   id         short name, used for out/<id>/ and in RESULTS.md
#   tier       1 runs by default (small, minutes in all); 2 and 3 are opt-in with --tier
#   toolchain  the project's lean-toolchain at that commit (`cargo xtask oracle build` checks it)
#   subdir     the Lake project's directory in the repository (. for the top)
#   roots      modules to build and export, comma-separated
#   prefixes   module-name prefixes of the project's own modules, comma-separated: the export
#              is the closure of the non-internal constants declared in them
#   cache      yes: run `lake exe cache get` before building (Mathlib-based projects)
